text:
helen: Quick security bulletin: we've detected anomalous SignBlob usage tied to the model registry signing key (mreg-signing-prod). As precaution, we're enforcing short-lived signing tokens and rotating the signing key. This thread is the official coordination channel.

sec-bot: [ALERT] unusual-crypto-usage mreg-signing-prod observed 2026-04-02T07:14:12Z.

omar: Plan outline: 1) create new KMS key mreg-signing-prod-v3, 2) deploy verifier to accept v3 while logging v1/v2 usage, 3) rotate service signing to use v3 with STS wrappers, 4) re-attest active deployments.

helen: Blast radius: hosted API + model-registry + Dedicated auto-sync. Private customers not auto-sync'd will be notified but not forced.

infra-oncall: Detection query to enumerate artifacts signed by old keys:
```
SELECT artifact_id, sha256, signed_by, signing_key, signing_ts
FROM model_signatures
WHERE signing_key LIKE 'mreg-signing-prod%'
AND signing_ts > '2025-06-01'
ORDER BY signing_ts DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

infra-oncall: And GCP log search for SignBlob calls:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"SignBlob\" AND resource.labels.project_id=\"redwood-prod\" AND protoPayload.request.serviceAccountEmail:*-mreg-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --limit 500
```

devex: SDK change: we'll add GetEphemeralSigningToken() and bump minor version. SDK will warn on long-lived key usage. Target release in 48h.

helen: Enforcement timeline: warn-mode for 24h, then hosted will hard-reject signatures from long-lived keys. Dedicated clusters get 72h unless they request an extension.

customers-success: I'll prepare customer emails for Dedicated accounts with auto-sync. Legal/Compliance: please review wording for customers with provenance/WORM requirements.

omar: Technical mitigation now: verifier will accept both old and new keys for a 2 hour overlap window but log and tag artifacts signed by old keys. After rotation completes, we will re-attest deployed artifacts with v3.

sec-bot: [TASK] SEC-ROTATE-998 created to track key creation, verifier patch, and re-attest jobs.

infra-oncall: Found two external CI runners calling SignBlob with mreg-sa credentials at 06:58 and 07:05 UTC. We've disabled those runners and rotated their tokens. Escalating to SecOps for fingerprinting.

helen: Action items assigned: omar -> KMS key + verifier patch (ETA 2h), infra-oncall -> artifact list + run re-sign job for top 100 deployed (ETA 4h), devex -> SDK minor release (48h), customers-success -> customer notices (1h).

devex: Note: we'll include an SDK helper that falls back to fetching the attestation when mismatch occurs and surfaces clear error messages.

omar: Rolling canary verifier patch to 5% now. Monitor attestation-verifier-errors and latency.

sec-bot: canary deployed verifier v4.0.0-canary -> 5% at 2026-04-02T07:42:10Z.

helen: Keep logs and decisions in INC-2026-MREG-07 for postmortem. We'll circle back with a short summary for execs after containment.

customers-success: Draft sent to CS for review. Will hold until infra confirms no customer action is required immediately.

infra-oncall: Re-sign job progress: 25/100 complete, no failures.

omar: Canary healthy. Proceeding to 25% rollout in 30m.

helen: Final note: old long-lived key access will be revoked after 72h and scheduled for destruction following our 7-day quarantine. If you own a service that signs artifacts, update to ephemeral flow ASAP. Ping this thread for help. :lock:
